proposedBy: Codex, implementing the LLP 0063 Step 4 closure request
ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as named by partitime.comparison-protocol.v1
baselinePolicy: No frozen Step 0 threshold is changed or loosened. Calibration thresholds for these newly admitted categories become immutable before the independently executed holdout cohort.

sampling.outlierPolicy: retain every valid sample; invalidate only a receipt-recorded instrument failure
sampling.cohortIsolation: The calibration receipt is committed before the holdout run. Holdout accepts an explicit committed calibration revision and reads thresholds from git, never from the mutable worktree.

navigation.coldStartupMs: Navigation start through the first product-shell/feed DOM mount, with the HTTP cache disabled and cleared before navigation.
navigation.warmStartupMs: Navigation start through the first product-shell/feed DOM mount after a same-cell cache-prime navigation, with the HTTP cache enabled.
navigation.firstAuthoritativeDataMs: Navigation start through a non-empty feed-ready DOM state produced by the cell provider.
navigation.firstLiveDataMs: Navigation start through the first simultaneous feed-ready state and settled connection indicator (live for push cells; polling for the protocol's declared polling cells).
navigation.observer: A pre-document MutationObserver installed by the browser harness records milestones without adding instrument code to any measured application bundle.

idle.cpuUnit: Chrome TaskDuration delta, converted to task milliseconds per wall-clock second after first-live-data and forced garbage collection
idle.networkUnit: CDP Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength plus WebSocket payload bytes per wall-clock second after first-live-data

memory.metric: Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize after first-live-data and forced garbage collection, divided by the feed workload's one active logical subscription

update.action: Activate the canonical open-event_swim control and wait for event-page to render.
update.fanout: Number of distinct DOM mutation targets observed from action dispatch through event-page readiness.
update.patches: Sum of attribute/characterData mutations and added/removed node counts over that same interval.
update.scope: DOM/host-visible effects only; framework-private scheduler work is intentionally excluded so all three authoring arms share one observer.

build.production: Fresh Vite production command duration for the named arm/backend cell; dependency-download time is excluded and the committed node_modules/lock state is retained.
build.incremental: Vite production watch rebuild duration after a one-newline change to a temporary mirror of the cell entry module; the repository worktree is never mutated.
build.clock: host monotonic clock around process completion for production; watcher BUNDLE_START/BUNDLE_END event clock for incremental

native.control: React Expo iOS carrier on the same host/OS/simulator profile

metrics.hermesEvaluationMs: Hermes entry evaluation duration reported by the carrier's structured launch stages: React Expo reads React Native's RCTPLScriptExecution duration at RCTJavaScriptDidLoadNotification; Exact reads hostStatus.load.stages.evaluateMs.
metrics.startupAssetWeightBytes: Sum of the JavaScript or Hermes startup assets actually admitted by the qualifying carrier launch (React Expo main.jsbundle/HBC; Exact hostStatus.load.scriptBytes), excluding native binaries, symbols, and test artifacts. Build/profile mode remains receipt-visible.
metrics.coldLaunchMs: External process launch request through the carrier's first interactive app marker after terminating the prior app process (React Expo's first committed root-effect device-launch event; Exact's firstAppFrameAt).
metrics.firstAuthoritativeDataMs: Process launch request through the first structured authoritative-data event for the canonical feed.

reportOnlyProfiles: Exact macOS has no React Expo same-OS control in workload v1.
React Expo Android has no Exact + Contract Android carrier in workload v1.

capabilityToggles: backend mode: snapback versus the same-arm gateway average
authoring mode: contract/react versus the vanilla same-backend lower bound
transport mode: push versus declared polling cells
attribution.rule: Every production build emits a non-executable module ledger; combined delta buckets remain labelled as lower bounds and are never presented as isolated framework truth.
